questions.stem: Winslow Corp. is a domestic registrant with a December 31 fiscal year end that does not qualify as a smaller reporting company. Winslow is preparing its annual report on Form 10-K for the year ended December 31, Year 5. Which set of audited financial statements does Regulation S-X require Winslow to present?

choices.label: A
choices.text: Balance sheets as of December 31, Year 5 and Year 4, and statements of income, comprehensive income, cash flows, and changes in stockholders' equity for Year 5, Year 4, and Year 3

choices.label: B
choices.text: Balance sheets as of December 31, Year 5, Year 4, and Year 3, and statements of income, comprehensive income, cash flows, and changes in stockholders' equity for Year 5, Year 4, and Year 3

choices.label: C
choices.text: Balance sheets as of December 31, Year 5 and Year 4, and statements of income, comprehensive income, cash flows, and changes in stockholders' equity for Year 5 and Year 4

choices.label: D
choices.text: A balance sheet as of December 31, Year 5 only, and statements of income, comprehensive income, cash flows, and changes in stockholders' equity for Year 5, Year 4, and Year 3

questions.explanation: Regulation S-X requires audited balance sheets as of the end of each of the two most recent fiscal years, and audited statements of income, comprehensive income, cash flows, and changes in stockholders' equity for each of the three most recent fiscal years. Winslow therefore presents two balance sheets (Year 5 and Year 4) and three years of the remaining statements (Year 5, Year 4, and Year 3). Presenting only two years of income, comprehensive income, cash flow, and equity statements is the scaled accommodation available under Article 8 to smaller reporting companies, which Winslow is not. A third balance sheet as of the end of Year 3 is never required. A single balance sheet is insufficient because comparative balance sheet information is required.
questions.explanationJa: Regulation S-X は、監査済み貸借対照表を直近2事業年度末時点で、損益計算書・包括利益計算書・キャッシュフロー計算書・株主持分変動計算書を直近3事業年度分、それぞれ提示することを求める。したがって Winslow は貸借対照表2期（Year 5・Year 4）と、その他の計算書3期（Year 5・Year 4・Year 3）を表示する。損益・キャッシュフロー等を2期しか出さないのは Article 8 に基づく小規模報告会社（SRC）向けの軽減措置であり、SRC でない Winslow には適用されない。貸借対照表を3期出す要求はなく、また1期のみでは比較情報の要求を満たさない。

questions.subtopic: Regulation S-X Article 8 — Smaller Reporting Companies
questions.stem: Bell Instruments Inc. qualifies as a smaller reporting company and files an annual report on Form 10-K. Under Article 8 of Regulation S-X, which financial statements must Bell present?

choices.label: A
choices.text: Audited balance sheets as of the two most recent fiscal year ends, and audited statements of income, cash flows, and changes in stockholders' equity for the three most recent fiscal years

choices.label: B
choices.text: An audited balance sheet as of the most recent fiscal year end only, and audited statements of income, cash flows, and changes in stockholders' equity for the two most recent fiscal years

choices.label: C
choices.text: Unaudited balance sheets as of the two most recent fiscal year ends, and unaudited statements of income, cash flows, and changes in stockholders' equity for the two most recent fiscal years

choices.label: D
choices.text: Audited balance sheets as of the two most recent fiscal year ends, and audited statements of income, cash flows, and changes in stockholders' equity for the two most recent fiscal years

questions.explanation: Article 8 of Regulation S-X scales the financial statement requirements for smaller reporting companies: two audited balance sheets, as of the end of each of the two most recent fiscal years, and two years of audited statements of income, cash flows, and changes in stockholders' equity. The accommodation reduces the income statement, cash flow, and equity statements from three years to two; it does not reduce the number of balance sheets and it does not waive the audit requirement, so a single balance sheet and unaudited statements are both incorrect. Three years of income, cash flow, and equity statements is the requirement for registrants that are not smaller reporting companies.
questions.explanationJa: Regulation S-X の Article 8 は、小規模報告会社（SRC）向けに財務諸表要件を軽減している。監査済み貸借対照表は直近2事業年度末の2期分、損益計算書・キャッシュフロー計算書・株主持分変動計算書は直近2事業年度分でよい。軽減されるのは損益・キャッシュフロー・持分の3期→2期という部分であり、貸借対照表の期数が1期に減るわけでも、監査が免除されるわけでもない。したがって貸借対照表1期のみとする選択肢も、未監査でよいとする選択肢も誤り。損益等を3期分とするのは SRC 以外の登録会社に対する要求である。

questions.subtopic: Regulation S-X Article 11 — Pro Forma Information
questions.stem: Harlow Industries Inc., a calendar-year registrant, acquired a significant business on November 1, Year 5, and must file pro forma financial information under Article 11 of Regulation S-X. Harlow's most recently completed fiscal year ended December 31, Year 4, and its most recent interim balance sheet is as of September 30, Year 5. How is the pro forma financial information presented?

choices.label: A
choices.text: Both the pro forma balance sheet and the pro forma income statements are presented as if the acquisition had occurred on January 1, Year 4

choices.label: B
choices.text: The pro forma balance sheet is presented as if the acquisition had occurred on September 30, Year 5, the date of the most recent balance sheet, while the pro forma income statements for Year 4 and for the nine months ended September 30, Year 5 are presented as if the acquisition had occurred on January 1, Year 4, the beginning of the most recently completed fiscal year

choices.label: C
choices.text: Both the pro forma balance sheet and the pro forma income statements are presented as if the acquisition had occurred on November 1, Year 5, the actual acquisition date

choices.label: D
choices.text: Only a pro forma income statement covering November 1, Year 5 through the end of the period is required; a pro forma balance sheet may not be presented

questions.explanation: Article 11 uses two different assumed dates. The pro forma condensed balance sheet is prepared as if the transaction had occurred as of the date of the most recent balance sheet filed, which for Harlow is September 30, Year 5. The pro forma condensed income statements are prepared as if the transaction had occurred as of the beginning of the registrant's most recently completed fiscal year, January 1, Year 4, and that assumption carries through the most recent interim period presented. Using January 1, Year 4 for the balance sheet as well would restate a financial position that has already been measured at a later date. Using the actual November 1, Year 5 acquisition date for the income statements would defeat the purpose of pro forma information, which is to show a full period of combined results. A pro forma balance sheet is omitted only when the transaction is already reflected in the historical balance sheet filed, which is not the case here because the acquisition occurred after September 30, Year 5.
questions.explanationJa: Article 11 では、プロフォーマ貸借対照表とプロフォーマ損益計算書で仮定する取引発生日が異なる。プロフォーマ要約貸借対照表は、提出する直近の貸借対照表日（Harlow では Year 5 年9月30日）に取引が発生したものとして作成する。一方、プロフォーマ要約損益計算書は、直近に完了した事業年度の期首（Year 4 年1月1日）に取引が発生したものとして作成し、その仮定を表示対象の直近中間期まで引き継ぐ。貸借対照表まで Year 4 年1月1日基準にすると、より新しい時点で既に測定されている財政状態を遡って組み替えることになり適切でない。損益計算書を実際の取得日（Year 5 年11月1日）基準にすると、結合後の1期間まるごとの業績を示すというプロフォーマ情報の目的が失われる。プロフォーマ貸借対照表が不要になるのは、取引が既に提出済みの歴史的貸借対照表に反映されている場合に限られ、本問は取得が9月30日より後であるため該当しない。

questions.subtopic: Regulation S-X Rule 10-01 — Interim Financial Statements
questions.stem: Delgado Corp., a calendar-year registrant that is not a smaller reporting company, is preparing the Form 10-Q for its third quarter ended September 30, Year 6. Under Rule 10-01 of Regulation S-X, which presentation of interim financial statements is required?

choices.label: A
choices.text: Audited condensed financial statements covering the three months and the nine months ended September 30, Year 6

choices.label: B
choices.text: Condensed balance sheets as of September 30, Year 6 and September 30, Year 5, and condensed statements of income and cash flows for the three months ended on each of those dates

choices.label: C
choices.text: Condensed balance sheets as of September 30, Year 6 and December 31, Year 5; condensed income statements for the three months and the nine months ended September 30, Year 6 and September 30, Year 5; and condensed statements of cash flows for the nine months ended September 30, Year 6 and September 30, Year 5

choices.label: D
choices.text: A condensed balance sheet as of September 30, Year 6 only, and condensed statements of income and cash flows for the nine months ended September 30, Year 6 and September 30, Year 5

questions.explanation: Rule 10-01 requires an interim condensed balance sheet as of the end of the most recent fiscal quarter together with a balance sheet as of the end of the preceding fiscal year, which supplies the comparison point for financial position. Income statements are required for the current quarter and for the year-to-date period, each with the comparable period of the prior year. Statements of cash flows are required only for the year-to-date period and the comparable prior-year period, not for the individual quarter. Interim financial statements in Form 10-Q may be unaudited, so requiring audited statements is incorrect. Comparing the September 30, Year 6 balance sheet with a September 30, Year 5 balance sheet rather than with the December 31, Year 5 year-end balance sheet is not the required presentation, and omitting the prior fiscal year end balance sheet entirely removes the required comparative financial position.
questions.explanationJa: Rule 10-01 は、中間要約貸借対照表として直近四半期末時点のものと、比較対象となる前事業年度末時点のものを求める。損益計算書は当四半期分と期首からの累計期間分を、それぞれ前年度の対応期間とあわせて表示する。キャッシュフロー計算書は期首からの累計期間分と前年同累計期間分のみでよく、四半期単独期間の表示は要求されない。Form 10-Q の中間財務諸表は未監査でよいため、監査済みを求める選択肢は誤り。貸借対照表の比較対象を前年同四半期末（Year 5 年9月30日）とするのは要求されている形式ではなく、前事業年度末の貸借対照表を省けば必要な比較財政状態が失われる。

questions.stem: Which of the following best describes what Item 303 of Regulation S-K requires a registrant to provide in Management's Discussion and Analysis?

choices.label: A
choices.text: A narrative explanation of the registrant's financial condition, changes in financial condition, and results of operations viewed through the eyes of management, including discussion of liquidity, capital resources, material cash requirements, and critical accounting estimates

choices.label: B
choices.text: A table of selected financial data for the five most recent fiscal years, accompanied by a narrative explanation of each year-over-year change in the table

choices.label: C
choices.text: A forecast of the following year's revenue and earnings per share, together with the assumptions underlying the forecast

choices.label: D
choices.text: A restatement of the audited financial statements in narrative form, limited to information already presented in the notes

questions.explanation: The stated objective of MD&A is to give investors information material to an assessment of the registrant's financial condition and results of operations, presented from management's perspective, so that a reader can judge whether past performance is indicative of future performance. Required content includes liquidity and capital resources, material cash requirements, results of operations, and critical accounting estimates. A five-year selected financial data table is no longer a required disclosure. Forward-looking earnings forecasts are voluntary rather than mandatory. Simply repeating the financial statements in narrative form fails the requirement, because MD&A must add management's explanation of underlying causes, trends, and uncertainties rather than restate amounts already reported.
questions.explanationJa: MD&A の目的は、登録会社の財政状態と経営成績を評価するうえで重要な情報を経営者の視点から投資家に提供し、過去の業績が将来の業績を示唆するものかどうかを読者が判断できるようにすることにある。要求される内容には、流動性と資本の源泉、重要な資金需要、経営成績、重要な会計上の見積りが含まれる。5年分の選定財務データ表は現在では要求されていない。翌期の収益・EPS 予想の開示は任意であり義務ではない。財務諸表を文章に言い換えただけの記述では要件を満たさない。MD&A では、既に報告済みの数値を繰り返すのではなく、その背後にある要因・トレンド・不確実性について経営者自身の説明を加える必要がある。

questions.stem: Under Item 105 of Regulation S-K, how must a registrant present the risk factor disclosure in its Form 10-K?

choices.label: A
choices.text: Disclosure is limited to risks that management considers more likely than not to occur, and each risk must be quantified in dollars

choices.label: B
choices.text: Risk factors may be placed anywhere in the filing in any order, because the SEC does not prescribe a format for them

choices.label: C
choices.text: Risk factors must be reviewed and cleared by the SEC staff before the registrant may file the annual report

choices.label: D
choices.text: Risk factors must be concise and organized under relevant headings; if the section exceeds 15 pages it must be preceded by a summary of no more than two pages; and risks that could apply generically to any registrant must be placed at the end under a separate 'General Risk Factors' heading

questions.explanation: Item 105 requires a concise, logically organized discussion of the material factors that make an investment in the registrant speculative or risky, presented under relevant headings. A risk factor summary of no more than two pages is required when the risk factor section exceeds 15 pages, and generic risks that could apply to any registrant must be disclosed at the end under a separate 'General Risk Factors' caption so that entity-specific risks are not obscured. The disclosure standard is materiality rather than a more-likely-than-not threshold, and quantification of each risk in dollars is not required. The item prescribes both placement and organization, so describing the format as unregulated is incorrect. The SEC staff does not pre-clear the risk factors in a periodic report before it may be filed.
questions.explanationJa: Item 105 は、その登録会社への投資を投機的またはリスクの高いものにしている重要な要因について、関連する見出しの下に整理した簡潔な記述を求めている。リスクファクターの節が15ページを超える場合は、2ページ以内の要約を冒頭に付すことが求められる。また、どの登録会社にも当てはまりうる一般的なリスクは、企業固有のリスクが埋もれないよう、末尾に 'General Risk Factors' という独立の見出しを設けてそこに記載する。判断基準は重要性であって発生可能性が50%超かどうかではなく、各リスクを金額で定量化する要求もない。配置と構成の両方が規定されているため、書式が規制されていないとする説明は誤り。また定期報告書のリスクファクターについて、提出前に SEC スタッフの事前承認を得る仕組みは存在しない。

questions.subtopic: Regulation S-K versus Regulation S-X Scope
questions.stem: Which of the following disclosures in a Form 10-K is prescribed by Regulation S-K rather than by Regulation S-X?

choices.label: A
choices.text: The number of fiscal years of audited statements of cash flows that must be presented

choices.label: B
choices.text: The description of the registrant's business, including its principal products and services and its human capital resources

choices.label: C
choices.text: The circumstances under which separate audited financial statements of a significant equity method investee must be filed

choices.label: D
choices.text: The form and content of the schedule of valuation and qualifying accounts filed with the financial statements

questions.explanation: Regulation S-K governs the non-financial-statement portions of a filing, including the description of the business, properties, legal proceedings, risk factors, MD&A, and executive compensation. The narrative description of the business and its human capital resources is therefore an S-K requirement. Regulation S-X governs the form, content, and periods of the financial statements themselves and of their related schedules, so the number of years of audited cash flow statements, the rules requiring separate financial statements of a significant equity method investee, and the form and content of financial statement schedules such as valuation and qualifying accounts are all Regulation S-X matters.
questions.explanationJa: Regulation S-K は、提出書類のうち財務諸表以外の部分、すなわち事業の記述、資産・設備、訴訟、リスクファクター、MD&A、役員報酬などを規定する。事業内容と人的資本に関する記述的開示はこの S-K の要求事項にあたる。これに対し Regulation S-X は、財務諸表そのものの様式・内容・対象期間と、それに付随する明細表を規定する。したがって、監査済みキャッシュフロー計算書を何期分表示するかという要求、重要な持分法投資先の個別財務諸表の提出が必要となる場合の規定、評価性引当金等の明細表の様式と内容は、いずれも Regulation S-X が扱う事項である。

questions.stem: What is the primary purpose of the SEC requirement that registrants tag their financial statement information using XBRL?

choices.label: A
choices.text: To eliminate the requirement that financial statements be presented in a human-readable format

choices.label: B
choices.text: To give the SEC staff a mechanism for pre-approving the accounting policies that a registrant applies

choices.label: C
choices.text: To present reported data in a standardized, machine-readable format so that investors, analysts, and analytical software can extract and compare amounts across companies and across periods without re-keying the data

choices.label: D
choices.text: To replace the notes to the financial statements with a standardized data file

questions.explanation: XBRL assigns standardized, machine-readable tags to individual reported facts so that the data can be consumed directly by analytical tools. The benefit is comparability and efficiency: a user can pull the same line item from many registrants and many periods without manually re-entering amounts, which also removes transcription error. XBRL supplements rather than replaces the human-readable presentation, and it does not replace the notes, which are themselves subject to detail tagging. XBRL is a data format requirement and has nothing to do with the SEC approving a registrant's accounting policies.
questions.explanationJa: XBRL は、報告された個々の事実に標準化された機械可読タグを付与し、分析ツールがそのデータを直接読み取れるようにする仕組みである。利点は比較可能性と効率性にあり、利用者は多数の登録会社・多数の期間から同じ項目を手入力なしに抽出できるため、転記誤りも生じない。XBRL は人間が読む形式の表示を置き換えるものではなく補完するものであり、注記を置き換えるものでもない（注記自体も詳細タグ付けの対象である）。また XBRL はあくまでデータ形式に関する要求であり、SEC が登録会社の会計方針を承認する仕組みとは無関係である。

questions.stem: Orchard Systems Inc. is tagging the financial statements included in its Form 10-K. One expense caption, 'Amortization of contract acquisition costs,' does not correspond to any element in the US GAAP Financial Reporting Taxonomy. What is the appropriate action?

choices.label: A
choices.text: Create a custom extension element for the caption, because the taxonomy permits extensions when no standard element fairly represents the item as reported

choices.label: B
choices.text: Apply the standard taxonomy element closest in meaning even though it describes a different item, because extension elements are prohibited

choices.label: C
choices.text: Leave the caption untagged, because only captions that match a standard element are required to be tagged

choices.label: D
choices.text: Change the financial statement caption so that it matches an existing standard taxonomy element

questions.explanation: The US GAAP Financial Reporting Taxonomy supplies standard elements for commonly reported facts, and a registrant is expected to use a standard element whenever one appropriately represents the fact being reported. When no standard element does, the registrant creates a custom extension element so that the tagged data faithfully describes what was reported. Forcing the amount into an element that means something different would misrepresent the data and defeat the comparability the requirement is intended to produce. Every amount required to be tagged must be tagged, so omitting the line item is not permitted. Altering the financial statement caption to fit the taxonomy reverses the relationship between the tags and the underlying presentation: the tagging follows the financial statements, not the other way around.
questions.explanationJa: US GAAP 財務報告タクソノミは、一般的に報告される事実について標準要素を用意しており、報告する事実を適切に表す標準要素がある場合は必ずそれを使用する。適切な標準要素が存在しない場合に限り、登録会社は拡張要素（カスタム要素）を作成し、タグ付けされたデータが報告内容を忠実に表すようにする。意味の異なる要素に無理に当てはめれば、データが実態を誤って表し、この制度が目指す比較可能性も損なわれる。タグ付けが要求される金額はすべてタグ付けしなければならないため、その行項目を未タグのまま残すことは認められない。また、タクソノミに合わせて財務諸表の科目名を変えるのは本末転倒であり、タグ付けが財務諸表に従うのであって、その逆ではない。

questions.subtopic: Inline XBRL — Mechanics and Covered Filings
questions.stem: Which of the following statements about Inline XBRL is correct?

choices.label: A
choices.text: Inline XBRL is a voluntary alternative available to large accelerated filers; all other filers must continue to submit a separate XBRL exhibit

choices.label: B
choices.text: Inline XBRL applies only to annual reports on Form 10-K; quarterly and current reports are exempt from any tagging requirement

choices.label: C
choices.text: Inline XBRL requires the tagged data to be submitted as a separate exhibit within one business day after the related HTML document is filed

choices.label: D
choices.text: Inline XBRL embeds the machine-readable tags directly in the HTML filing document, so a single document serves both human readers and analytical software; it covers the face of the financial statements, the notes, and specified cover page information

questions.explanation: Inline XBRL places the tags inside the HTML filing itself rather than in a separate exhibit, so the filed document is simultaneously human-readable and machine-readable and there is only one version of the data. The requirement is mandatory across filer categories rather than optional for the largest filers; it was phased in by filer status, not limited to one status. Tagging is not confined to the annual report, because the financial statements and notes in quarterly reports are tagged and specified cover page data of annual, quarterly, and current reports is tagged as well. Because the tags are embedded in the document as filed, there is no separate exhibit and no one-business-day lag.
questions.explanationJa: インライン XBRL は、タグを別添のエグジビットではなく HTML の提出書類そのものの中に埋め込む方式である。その結果、提出された1つの書類が人間にも機械にも読める形となり、データのバージョンも1つで済む。この方式は最大手の提出会社だけの任意選択ではなく全区分に義務付けられており、提出会社の区分ごとに段階的に適用が開始されたにすぎない。対象も年次報告書に限られず、四半期報告書の財務諸表と注記もタグ付けされ、さらに年次・四半期・臨時の各報告書について指定された表紙情報もタグ付けの対象となる。タグは提出書類自体に埋め込まれるため、別添エグジビットも1営業日の猶予も存在しない。

questions.stem:
Vance Manufacturing Inc. has five operating segments. Information for the year just ended is as follows (in thousands):

Segment | External revenue | Intersegment revenue | Profit (loss) | Assets
Alpha | $400,000 | $100,000 | $90,000 | $600,000
Beta | $260,000 | $0 | $40,000 | $300,000
Gamma | $90,000 | $10,000 | $(60,000) | $150,000
Delta | $60,000 | $0 | $5,000 | $130,000
Epsilon | $40,000 | $0 | $(5,000) | $70,000

Applying the quantitative thresholds of ASC 280, which operating segments are reportable segments?

choices.label: A
choices.text: Alpha and Beta only

choices.label: B
choices.text: Alpha, Beta, and Gamma only

choices.label: C
choices.text: Alpha, Beta, Gamma, and Delta

choices.label: D
choices.text: All five operating segments

questions.explanation: An operating segment is reportable if it meets any one of the three 10% tests. Revenue test: combined revenue including intersegment revenue is $960,000, so the threshold is $96,000; Alpha at $500,000, Beta at $260,000, and Gamma at $100,000 clear it, while Delta at $60,000 and Epsilon at $40,000 do not. Profit or loss test: the combined profit of the segments reporting a profit is $135,000 ($90,000 + $40,000 + $5,000) and the combined loss of the segments reporting a loss is $65,000 ($60,000 + $5,000), so the benchmark is the greater absolute amount of $135,000 and the threshold is $13,500; Alpha, Beta, and Gamma's $60,000 loss clear it, while Delta's $5,000 and Epsilon's $5,000 do not. Asset test: total segment assets are $1,250,000, so the threshold is $125,000, which Alpha, Beta, Gamma, and Delta clear while Epsilon at $70,000 does not. Delta is reportable solely because of the asset test, which is why stopping at three segments is wrong, and Gamma qualifies despite reporting a loss because the test uses the absolute amount. Epsilon fails all three tests, so treating every operating segment as reportable overstates the result. The reportable segments' external revenue of $810,000 is 95% of consolidated external revenue of $850,000, so the 75% requirement is already satisfied and no additional segment must be added.
questions.explanationJa: 営業セグメントは、3つの10%テストのいずれか1つを満たせば報告セグメントとなる。収益テスト：セグメント間収益を含む合計収益は $960,000 なので閾値は $96,000。Alpha（$500,000）、Beta（$260,000）、Gamma（$100,000）が超え、Delta（$60,000）と Epsilon（$40,000）は超えない。損益テスト：利益を計上したセグメントの合計利益は $135,000（$90,000＋$40,000＋$5,000）、損失を計上したセグメントの合計損失は $65,000（$60,000＋$5,000）であり、絶対値の大きい $135,000 が基準となるため閾値は $13,500。Alpha、Beta、および損失 $60,000 の Gamma が超え、Delta の $5,000 と Epsilon の $5,000 は超えない。資産テスト：セグメント資産合計は $1,250,000 なので閾値は $125,000 で、Alpha・Beta・Gamma・Delta が超え、Epsilon の $70,000 は超えない。Delta は資産テストのみで報告対象となるため、3セグメントで止める解答は誤り。Gamma は損失計上だが、テストは絶対値で判定するため該当する。Epsilon は3テストすべてを満たさないので、5セグメントすべてを報告対象とするのは過大である。報告セグメントの外部収益合計 $810,000 は連結外部収益 $850,000 の95%であり、75%要件は既に満たされているため追加すべきセグメントはない。

questions.stem:
Vantage Holdings Inc. has ten operating segments, none of which has intersegment revenue. Revenue from external customers, in thousands, is as follows:

Segment | External revenue
P | $3,000
Q | $1,400
R | $900
S | $850
T | $800
U | $750
V | $700
W | $650
X | $550
Y | $400

Consolidated revenue from external customers is $10,000. Only P and Q satisfy any of the three 10% quantitative thresholds. Vantage identifies additional reportable segments in descending order of external revenue as needed. How many reportable segments must Vantage present?

choices.label: A
choices.text: Two

choices.label: B
choices.text: Six

choices.label: C
choices.text: Five

choices.label: D
choices.text: Ten

questions.explanation: After the 10% tests are applied, the reportable segments must together account for at least 75% of consolidated revenue from external customers, which is $7,500 here. P and Q alone provide $4,400, or 44%, so additional operating segments must be identified as reportable even though none of them meets a 10% threshold. Adding R brings the total to $5,300, adding S brings it to $6,150, adding T brings it to $6,950, which is still only 69.5%, and adding U brings it to $7,700, or 77%, which finally satisfies the test. The result is six reportable segments: P, Q, R, S, T, and U. Stopping at two segments applies only the 10% tests and ignores the 75% requirement. Stopping at five segments leaves external revenue at $6,950, short of the $7,500 needed. Treating all ten operating segments as reportable overstates the requirement, because segments are added only until the 75% level is reached.
questions.explanationJa: 10%テストを適用した後、報告セグメントの外部顧客からの収益合計が連結外部収益の75%以上を占めている必要がある。本問では $7,500 が基準となる。P と Q だけでは $4,400（44%）にとどまるため、10%閾値を満たさない営業セグメントであっても追加で報告セグメントとしなければならない。R を加えて $5,300、S を加えて $6,150、T を加えて $6,950（69.5%）でまだ不足し、U を加えて $7,700（77%）となって初めて要件を満たす。したがって報告セグメントは P・Q・R・S・T・U の6つとなる。2つで止めるのは10%テストだけを適用して75%要件を無視した解答であり、5つで止めると外部収益が $6,950 となり必要な $7,500 に届かない。10セグメントすべてを報告対象とするのは過大で、75%に達した時点で追加は終了する。

questions.stem: Under ASC 280, when may two operating segments be aggregated into a single reportable segment?

choices.label: A
choices.text: When aggregation is consistent with the objective and basic principles of segment reporting, the segments have similar economic characteristics, and the segments are similar in the nature of their products and services, the nature of their production processes, the type or class of customer, the methods used to distribute their products or provide their services, and, if applicable, the nature of the regulatory environment

choices.label: B
choices.text: Whenever neither of the two segments individually satisfies any of the 10% quantitative thresholds

choices.label: C
choices.text: Whenever the two segments report to the same segment manager, regardless of the products and services they provide

choices.label: D
choices.text: Whenever the combined external revenue of the two segments is less than 10% of consolidated revenue from external customers

questions.explanation: Aggregation is permitted only when it is consistent with the core principle of segment reporting, the segments have similar economic characteristics, and the segments are similar in every one of the specified areas: nature of products and services, nature of production processes, type or class of customer, distribution methods, and the nature of the regulatory environment where that is relevant. The criteria are cumulative, so failing any one of them prevents aggregation. Falling below the quantitative thresholds does not by itself allow aggregation; information about segments that do not meet the thresholds may be combined only if those segments share a majority of the aggregation criteria, and otherwise they are reported in an all other category. Sharing a segment manager is part of how an operating segment is identified in the first place and is not a substitute for economic similarity. A combined revenue level below 10% describes size, not the economic and operational similarity that aggregation requires.
questions.explanationJa: 集約が認められるのは、集約がセグメント報告の基本原則と整合し、当該セグメント同士の経済的特徴が類似しており、かつ、製品・サービスの性質、生産プロセスの性質、顧客の種類または階層、製品の配送方法やサービスの提供方法、および該当する場合は規制環境の性質という指定された各領域のすべてにおいて類似している場合に限られる。これらの要件は累積的であり、1つでも満たさなければ集約できない。量的閾値を下回っていること自体は集約を認める根拠にならない。閾値を満たさないセグメントの情報を結合できるのは、それらが集約要件の過半を共有している場合に限られ、そうでなければ「その他」区分として報告する。同じセグメントマネジャーの下にあることは、そもそも営業セグメントを識別する際の要素であって、経済的類似性の代わりにはならない。また合計収益が10%未満という事実は規模を示すにすぎず、集約に必要な経済的・事業運営上の類似性を示すものではない。

questions.stem: Kelso Corp., a publicly traded enterprise, has identified three reportable segments. Which of the following must Kelso disclose in its segment footnote?

choices.label: A
choices.text: A complete balance sheet and a complete statement of cash flows for each reportable segment

choices.label: B
choices.text: Segment profit or loss for each reportable segment recomputed in conformity with GAAP, because a measure that departs from GAAP may not be presented

choices.label: C
choices.text: The measure of segment profit or loss reviewed by the chief operating decision maker, even if that measure is not determined in accordance with GAAP, together with a reconciliation of the total of the reportable segments' amounts to the corresponding consolidated amount

choices.label: D
choices.text: Total assets for each reportable segment in every case, whether or not asset information is regularly provided to the chief operating decision maker

questions.explanation: Segment reporting follows the management approach, so the amounts disclosed are those reported internally to the chief operating decision maker for purposes of allocating resources and assessing performance, even when the measure of segment profit or loss is not a GAAP measure. To keep the disclosure useful, the entity must explain how the measure is determined and reconcile the totals of the reportable segments' revenues, profit or loss, assets, and other significant items to the corresponding consolidated amounts. Recomputing each segment's results under GAAP would contradict the management approach. Complete segment balance sheets and statements of cash flows are not required, because only specified items are disclosed. Total segment assets are disclosed only when that information is regularly provided to the chief operating decision maker, so an unconditional requirement is incorrect. Separately, entity-wide disclosures about products and services, geographic areas, and major customers are required of all public entities, including those with a single reportable segment.
questions.explanationJa: セグメント報告はマネジメント・アプローチに従うため、開示される金額は、資源配分と業績評価のために最高経営意思決定者（CODM）へ内部報告されている金額であり、セグメント損益の測定値が GAAP に準拠していなくてもそのまま開示する。開示の有用性を保つため、企業はその測定値がどのように算定されているかを説明し、報告セグメントの収益・損益・資産その他の重要項目の合計を、対応する連結金額へ調整（レコンサイル）しなければならない。各セグメントの業績を GAAP ベースで計算し直すことはマネジメント・アプローチと矛盾する。セグメントごとの完全な貸借対照表やキャッシュフロー計算書は要求されておらず、開示対象は定められた項目に限られる。セグメント資産合計の開示が必要となるのは、その情報が CODM へ定期的に提供されている場合であり、無条件の要求ではない。なお、製品・サービス別、地域別、主要顧客に関する企業全体の開示は、報告セグメントが1つだけの企業を含め、すべての公開企業に要求される。
